name: Acropolis
description: The rock above the city with the Parthenon on top. Go at opening time; there is little shade.

name: Acropolis Museum
description: A modern museum for the sculptures found on the Acropolis, built over an excavated neighbourhood.

name: Ancient Agora
description: The marketplace of classical Athens, with the well-preserved Temple of Hephaestus.

name: Plaka
description: The old quarter below the Acropolis, with stepped lanes and tavernas.

name: Mount Lycabettus
description: The highest hill in central Athens. Walk or take the funicular for the view.

name: Palace of Knossos
description: The largest Minoan palace, partly reconstructed, a short bus ride south of the city.

name: Heraklion Archaeological Museum
description: The best collection of Minoan art anywhere, including the frescoes from Knossos.

name: Koules Fortress
description: A Venetian sea fort at the mouth of the old harbour.

name: Ammoudara beach
description: A long sandy beach just west of the city.

name: Sagrada Familia
description: Gaudi's unfinished basilica. Entry is by timed ticket and often sells out.

name: Park Guell
description: A hillside park of mosaic terraces and odd pavilions, with views to the sea.

name: Gothic Quarter
description: The medieval core of the city, around the cathedral.

name: La Boqueria market
description: The big covered food market off La Rambla. Go in the morning.

name: Barceloneta beach
description: The closest city beach, wide and busy, with a long promenade.

name: Royal Alcazar
description: A palace in Moorish style with tiled halls and large gardens. Book ahead in high season.

name: Seville Cathedral and Giralda
description: One of the largest Gothic churches anywhere. The bell tower was once a minaret and can be climbed by ramp.

name: Plaza de Espana
description: A sweeping half-circle of brick and painted tiles beside Maria Luisa Park.

name: Triana
description: The old potters' and flamenco quarter across the river, with a covered market and many tapas bars.

name: Metropol Parasol
description: A huge wooden canopy with a rooftop walkway and views over the old town.

name: Eiffel Tower
description: The iron tower from 1889. Book a lift ticket ahead, or climb the stairs to the second floor.

name: Louvre
description: The largest art museum in the world. Choose a few sections; it can't be seen in a day.

name: Musee d'Orsay
description: Impressionist and nineteenth-century art in a former railway station.

name: Notre-Dame
description: The Gothic cathedral on an island in the Seine.

name: Montmartre and Sacre-Coeur
description: A hill of steep streets topped by a white basilica, with a view across the city.

name: Luxembourg Gardens
description: A formal park on the Left Bank with chairs around a pond.

name: Ramparts
description: A walk around the top of the old town's granite walls, above the beaches.

name: Fort National
description: A seventeenth-century fort on a tidal rock, reached on foot at low tide.

name: Grand Be
description: A tidal island with a wide sea view. Check the tide times before crossing.

name: Plage du Sillon
description: A three-kilometre sandy beach along the sea wall.

name: City walls
description: A two-kilometre walk around the top of the old town's walls. Start early in summer.

name: Stradun
description: The polished limestone main street of the old town.

name: Mount Srd
description: The hill behind the city, reached by cable car or a steep path, with a view over the roofs and islands.

name: Banje beach
description: A pebble beach just outside the eastern gate, looking back at the walls.

name: Lokrum island
description: A wooded island fifteen minutes away by boat, with rocks for swimming and a small salt lake.

name: Basilica of San Nicola
description: An eleventh-century church built to hold the relics of Saint Nicholas, and a place of pilgrimage ever since.

name: Bari Vecchia
description: The old town on its peninsula. Locals still make orecchiette pasta at tables in the street.

name: Swabian Castle
description: A moated fortress at the edge of the old town, rebuilt by Frederick II.

name: Pane e Pomodoro beach
description: The city beach: free, sandy and a short walk from the centre. People swim here from late spring to autumn.

name: Lungomare Nazario Sauro
description: A long seafront promenade lined with old street lamps, best around sunset.

name: Florence Cathedral
description: The Duomo, with Brunelleschi's brick dome. You can climb the dome with a timed ticket.

name: Uffizi Gallery
description: The great collection of Renaissance painting, including Botticelli's Birth of Venus.

name: Galleria dell'Accademia
description: Home of Michelangelo's David.

name: Ponte Vecchio
description: A medieval bridge still lined with goldsmiths' shops.

name: Piazzale Michelangelo
description: A terrace above the river with the classic view over the city. Walk up for sunset.

name: Colosseum
description: The largest amphitheatre of the Roman world. Go at opening time or late afternoon to avoid the worst queues.

name: Roman Forum
description: The ruined centre of ancient Rome, covered by the same ticket as the Colosseum.

name: Pantheon
description: A two-thousand-year-old temple with an open hole in its dome, still in use as a church.

name: Trevi Fountain
description: Rome's best-known baroque fountain. Quietest before breakfast.

name: Vatican Museums
description: The papal collections, ending in the Sistine Chapel. Book a timed ticket ahead.

name: Trastevere
description: A neighbourhood of narrow lanes across the Tiber, full of trattorias and bars.

name: Bryggen
description: A row of wooden merchant houses on the old Hanseatic wharf.

name: Mount Floyen
description: A hilltop above the centre, reached by funicular, with forest trails behind it.

name: Fish Market
description: Seafood stalls on the harbour, indoors and out.

name: KODE art museums
description: Four buildings by the city lake with Norwegian art, including works by Munch.

name: Mount Ulriken
description: The highest of Bergen's seven mountains. A cable car runs up, and a ridge walk leads across to Floyen.

name: Ponta da Piedade
description: A headland of golden cliffs, arches and sea caves. Walk the boardwalk or see it by kayak from below.

name: Praia Dona Ana
description: A sheltered cove under tall cliffs, within walking distance of town.

name: Praia do Camilo
description: A small beach reached by a long wooden staircase. It fills up early in summer.

name: Meia Praia
description: Several kilometres of open sand east of the harbour, with room even in August.

name: Lagos old town
description: Cobbled streets inside the old walls, with restaurants and a small fort by the water.

name: Belem Tower
description: A small sixteenth-century fortress on the river, from the age of Portuguese exploration.

name: Jeronimos Monastery
description: A richly carved monastery in the Manueline style. The famous custard tart bakery is next door.

name: Sao Jorge Castle
description: A hilltop castle above the Alfama quarter with wide views over the river.

name: Miradouro da Senhora do Monte
description: One of the highest viewpoints in the city, popular at sunset.

name: Time Out Market
description: A food hall in the old Ribeira market with stalls from well-known Lisbon kitchens.

name: Hagia Sophia
description: Built as a cathedral in the sixth century and now a mosque, with a vast dome.

name: Blue Mosque
description: The Sultan Ahmed Mosque, known for its blue tiles and six minarets.

name: Topkapi Palace
description: The palace of the Ottoman sultans, with courtyards, treasury and harem.

name: Grand Bazaar
description: One of the world's oldest covered markets, with thousands of small shops.

name: Galata Tower
description: A medieval stone tower across the Golden Horn with a viewing balcony.

name: Kadikoy market
description: Food streets on the Asian side, a short ferry ride away.
